title: FloodGuard Household Points on a RentGuard Multi-Policy Discount Restart
content:
**Desk guidance — restart household points.** A RentGuard Renters Policy customer who also holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force earns household points when the multi-policy discount on the renters policy restarts. The points turn on the FloodGuard policy's status and its original effective date, as the FloodGuard record shows them.

When the customer holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force whose original effective date is 24 whole months or more before today, 2 points are added to the discount percentages after the restart; when the customer holds a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force whose original effective date is fewer than 24 whole months before today, 1 point is added; when the customer holds no FloodGuard Private Flood Policy in force, no household points are added.

**Points of judgement**

- Only a FloodGuard policy with status in force counts; a cancelled or expired FloodGuard policy earns no household points.
- The age is taken from the FloodGuard original effective date (its first inception), in whole months up to today.
- At exactly 24 whole months: 2 points. At 23 whole months: 1 point.

| FloodGuard Private Flood Policy | Whole months since its original effective date | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| In force | 24 or more | 2 |
| In force | 0 to 23 | 1 |
| None in force | not applicable | 0 |
